sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.text: A hand lies on its side against a wall, coils back and trembles, then drags across the whole floor. Jump it (a double jump is safest) or dash through. If you jumped it, it may skid into the far wall, roll over and come back: be ready to jump again.

rain.name: Ember Rain
rain.text: The core squats and flings embers up, then meteors come down one after another on markers, every other one led to where you are heading. Keep moving and step off each marker before it lands.

sweep2.name: Double Sweep
sweep2.text: The sweep from the second phase on: the hand drags across the floor, pauses a breath at the far wall, and always comes straight back, quicker the second time. Jump it both ways, or dash through.

pulse.name: Corona Pulse
pulse.text: The core moves to the middle, draws in on itself and trembles, then a ring of light bursts out across the whole arena, two or three in a row. Dash through each ring as it reaches you.

comb.name: Comb
comb.text: Both hands hang upside down at the top of the screen and draw their fingers into claws while every other lane fills with light; then the columns rake down. Stand in a dark lane, and shift one lane over each volley, as the lit lanes swap.

tide.name: Burning Floor
tide.text: The core sinks and bears down while the whole floor fills with fire, then the floor burns for a few seconds. Get onto a platform before it lights, then watch for a lance aimed at you up there and move once its line locks.

duet.name: Duet
duet.text: A hand and the core attack together: a fist slam with a lance fired after it, or a sweep along the floor with meteors falling on you. Answer both at once: leave the fist's spot and move as the lance locks, or jump the hand and land clear of the markers.

duetSweep.name: Duet Sweep
duetSweep.text: A hand coils against a wall and sweeps the floor while three marked meteors come down on you one after another. Jump the hand as it reaches you and land clear of the markers; it does not come back.

dive.name: Dive
dive.text: The core flies up out of sight and a column follows you, then locks; it drops on that spot for two health, sending waves both ways and debris flying out. Leave the column as it locks, jump the wave, and stay close: the debris lands further out, and the core lies stuck in the floor to punish.

storm.name: Shard Storm
storm.text: Its shards fly out and lines are drawn through you one after another from different angles, each locking just before it fires. Step off each line as it locks; the last one runs flat along the floor, so jump it.

wheel.name: Eclipse Wheel
wheel.text: The core moves to the middle and two beams grow out of it on opposite sides; it winds back against the way it will turn, then the beams sweep a full circle through the arena. Dash through each beam as it reaches you, and keep off the meteor markers meanwhile.

singularity.name: Collapse
singularity.text: The core moves to the middle and a huge circle marks out around it while it drags you in. Walk or dash out against the pull and be outside the circle when it bursts, for two health. Afterwards the core sags, spent and open.

afterhands.name: Afterhands
afterhands.text: Its eye shuts and its hands sink flat into the floor. Void handprints bloom where you stood a moment ago, following you, then fists punch up from each in the order they were laid. Keep moving and never double back over your own trail.

pendulum.name: Pendulum
pendulum.text: A void chain takes the core and the hands haul it back with a creak. It swings across three or four times, faster each pass, low at the bottom and throwing embers ahead, then hangs over your end and slams down. Dash or double-jump through it at the bottom; leave the column at the end, then punish.

spears.name: Spears
spears.text: Spears of light form a rank along the far wall with one gap, at the height where the core hangs. Core sunk low: stay on the floor. Core raised: be up in a jump or on a platform, or dash through. Later a second rank comes back, and the core may bob between the heights, moving the gap.

comet.name: Comet
comet.text: The staff cradled at its face while a star swells on the head, then pushed off: a slow star that follows you and cannot be outrun for ever. Strike it to send it back into the Magus, which reels open. In the last phase it bats the star back once, faster: strike it again.

nova.name: Nova
nova.text: The answer to a hero at its side: it steps out of the air beside you and plants its staff. Staff low with frost creeping: a ring of frost runs both ways along the floor, so jump. Staff raised and spinning: a tall lightning dome, so get out sideways. Later it casts one of each.

serpent.name: Serpent
serpent.text: It swirls the staff low, then drives it into the floor, and fire comes up alive and slithers after you. One slow wide turn: one long serpent. Quick tight circles: two or three short fast ones. Jump them or cut them; later they leave burning ground.

spire.name: Spire
spire.text: Its answer to riding over its head: it looks up and lifts its staff straight up, and a rune opens over you, follows, then holds. A bolt drives down that column as frost spears up under it. Staying up there is no answer: leave the column once the rune holds.

motes.name: Motes
motes.text: Motes circle it, then leave one by one to hunt you. Staff level and turning slowly: slow ice motes that splinter when cut. Staff upright and rattling: fast lightning that darts over your head, stops and strikes below itself, so step out from under. Slanted between: both, in turn.

blink.name: Blinkfall
blink.text: It draws up tall and vanishes; its robe flickers where it will appear, then it drops staff-first, straight down if right over you, at a slant if off to one side. Two to four drops, the last sending waves along the floor (jump them). Then it slumps dizzy on its staff: a long opening.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.text: It blinks to the far wall and a wall of ice spears sweeps across with one gap, which the staff points at. Staff low, body bowed: the gap is at the floor, stay down. Staff up and level: the gap is at jump height, or on a platform. A dash goes through too; in the last phase the gap drifts as it comes.

blacksun.name: Black Sun
blacksun.text: Staff raised flat overhead in both hands, its three lights going out one by one; a black sun rises and void pours down over the whole floor but one gap of light. The gap slides, and later turns (the corona swells before a turn). Walk with the light until the sun goes down.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.text: It blinks up and away, its head tracks you and its eyes narrow to a slit; a crimson thread runs to where you will be, then a black spear flies down it, three in a row. As each thread appears, stop, turn, or dash the other way.

echo.name: Echo
echo.text: It kneels at the far wall, blades crossed before its face, and channels. Shadows fade in around you, set low, and dash to where you stand when their blade glints. Keep moving, and strike the shadows while they wait. In the last phase the final dash is the Veil itself; otherwise it is slow to rise.

stance.name: Stance
stance.text: It sheathes both blades and goes still. Strike it and it catches the blow, vanishes and cuts back through you: step or dash off the line. Wait, and it draws through you. Lead hand low by the hip: the cut runs along the floor (jump). High at the shoulder: it crosses at leaping height (stay down).

crescent.name: Crescent
crescent.text: A great curved blade thrown out past you that comes home to its hand. Overhand, arm wound high: it flies over you, then comes back low, so jump the return. Sidearm, swept low by the hip: out low along the floor (jump), back high (stay down).

skyhook.name: Skyhook
skyhook.text: Its answer to riding over its head: it looks up and a glint runs to you. Gone in rising smoke: it drops heel-first on that spot and a ripple runs both ways (move off, then jump the ripple). Sunk deep, blades turned up: it cuts straight up through the spot (just move off). It kneels open after.

snare.name: Snare
snare.text: It flicks knives strung with thread that pin where they land, hang slack, then snap straight when it yanks. Underhand throw: the thread lies across the floor at your ankles, so jump as it snaps. Overhand: threads cross high over you, so stay down under the cross. Its hand stays out after: open.

moonfall.name: Moonfall
moonfall.text: The light goes out and it leaps out of sight; a pale crescent of blades gathers over a wall, then sweeps across. Its hollow is the one way through: hollow low, stay on the ground; hollow high, be in the air or on a ledge. It lands where the last one ended and kneels open.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: It closes in and brings the greatsword down off its shoulder, over everything in front of and above it. Dash through to its back, or back right off. If you went through, the helm may turn and a low sweep comes behind it: jump. A stamp means another cut; a dragging blade means it is open.

cleave2.name: Cleave String
cleave2.text: The cleave from the second phase: quicker, and more often carried on. A stamp of the back foot brings a rising cut, and a second stamp another cut down. Count the stamps; when the blade drags instead, it is open. A blade burning red hits for two and throws a wave.

heel.name: Heel
heel.text: A cut behind it, for a hero who stays at its back. It glances over its shoulder first. Blade low: a sweep along the floor, so jump. Blade on the shoulder: a backhand at chest height, so stay down. Later its ghost repeats it, and in the last phase it carries straight into an overhead.

march.name: March
march.text: A string of cuts that goes on while you stay in reach. A long stride off its back foot means another cut; feet set wide with the sword hoisted in both hands means the finisher, for two health, which buries the blade. Back out of reach, then punish while it strains to pull the sword free.

souls.name: Souls
souls.text: It lifts its off hand and pale souls drift after you and hang overhead; left alone, each stops, draws in and splits into shards thrown at you. Hand cupped low and swelling: one great soul. Hand raised, fingers spread: many small ones. Cut them before they split, or step off the shard lines.

tolling.name: Tolling
tolling.text: It drives its greatsword point-down into the floor and a bell tolls underground. Rows of grave-blades too tall to jump burst up from both walls, each with one gap; the seams in the floor show where. Stand in the gap, then move to the next row's. It is open as it pulls the sword free.

requiem.name: Requiem
requiem.text: The music drops out and its blade goes black. It makes four to six silent cuts through empty air, each leaving a crimson tear hanging. Remember where they hang and be out of them: sword planted, they all open at once; sword lifted to the shoulder, one by one, last first.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.text: It kneels with its sword raised point up, and a giant void sword gathers above and follows you. It stops, plunges into the floor, then creaks and topples sideways like a felled tree. Get out from under the plunge, then to the side it is not leaning toward, or dash through it as it lands.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.text: It crouches with its spine arched high, spins once as its fire goes black, then flies as a void comet, bouncing off floor, walls and sky in straight lines. Each next line is drawn faintly before it travels it: be off it. It comes down with a burst and is open for a moment.

gyre.name: Gyre
gyre.text: It sinks, then rears up roaring in the middle of the bay as its coil rings the shore. Spouts tear up everywhere but one gap in the coil, starting on your side, and the ring turns, carrying the gap with it: keep walking with the gap. Then its head crashes down on the shore, spent.

gasp.name: Burnt Out
gasp.text: When Flare Up's aura burns out, he bends double, hands on his knees, and gasps twice. Nothing comes out of it: close in and hit him for the moment he is catching his breath.

lunge.name: Dash Thrust
lunge.text: His answer to a hero keeping away: the sword glows on his rack and he draws it at once, the point drawn back with a glint, then he dashes straight through to past where you stand. Jump over him or dash through as he comes; he lands open. If you are high above, he looses the bow instead.
